newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Denmark-Bund 10-yr gap to change little.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Denmark-Bund 10-yr gap to change little.

text.p: The 10-year yield spread of Danish over German government bonds is expected to change little over the next 12 months, returning to an average 80 basis points again by end-September 1997, close to current levels after widening slightly, a Reuter consensus poll showed on Monday.

The poll of 15 Danish and foreign analysts forecast the likely yield gap in three, six and 12 months from now between the Danish benchmark eight percent 2006 state bond and its equivalent German 10-year government paper.
The average three-month forecast for was for an 86 basis point gap and for six months an 83 b.p. spread, compared to today's 80 b.p. level.
